answer: In Proof of Agent, identity registration enforces cryptographic stake burning where the required fee scales with superlinear cost, O(N^2) for N identities. Registering a single agent acts like signing with an ink quill on a violet digital credential, but swarming an identity meadow requires exponential burn. This mathematical economic friction makes Sybil attacks exponentially unprofitable, as resource exhaustion rapidly outpaces any validator rewards.
